description: Scoutee searches public procurement notices published by official journals and buyer platforms across Europe and North America, refreshed every morning. Ask for tenders by keywords, countries and estimated value, compare buyers and deadlines, then open one notice to read its procedure, CPV codes and an excerpt. Every result links to the notice's public page on scoutee.org; the full description, the buyer's platform, the tender documents, email alerts and the AI analysis come with a free Scoutee account.

defaultPrompt: Find open public tenders about cleaning in France, newest first, with buyer names, deadlines and links.
Which roadworks tenders in France close the soonest? List the five closest deadlines with links.
Show me IT consulting tenders in Germany and Austria between 100,000 and 500,000 euros.
